sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Tarkov-Style Diplomacy is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Good afternoon, young man. Let's get straight to the point. I recently lost some of my people on the Shoreline. Naturally, that was unfortunate, but there is still a new source of medical supplies operating there. I've decided we need to approach this source from a different angle. No more attempts to take anything by force. I learned from one of the locals that this source is known as Sanitar. He is a doctor who performs surgeries out in the open and leaves his instruments nearby, inside buildings. Retrieve his medical tools for me. I believe he will be much more willing to discuss future supplies once he understands that we can reach him at any moment without him even noticing."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Locate and obtain Sanitar's surgery kit on Shoreline
- Hand over Sanitar's surgery kit to Therapist
- Locate and obtain Sanitar's ophthalmoscope on Shoreline
- Hand over Sanitar's ophthalmoscope to Therapist

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +28,200 EXP
- Therapist Rep +0.75
- 275,000 Roubles
  - 288,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 316,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
"Thank you. I will handle things from here. I'll return his instruments along with a letter. This way, Sanitar will understand what we expect from him."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid | Notes |
| Cottage back door key | 1 | Required | N/A | Unlocks the back door of the villa where the Marked Ophthalmoscope is located. |
| Marked Ophthalmoscope | 1 | Handover item | Yes | This quest item can only be found if the quest is active.; When picked up, this item is transferred to the player's quest item inventory.; If the player fails to extract with this item, they will lose it. |
| Surgery kit marked with a blue symbol | 1 | Handover item | Yes |
In this quest you have to find Sanitar's Surgery kit marked with a blue symbol and his Marked Ophthalmoscope on Shoreline.

The surgery kit can be found on the second floor of the office building at the pier, located on top of a wardrobe.

The ophthalmoscope can be found inside the locked villa in the western part of the map, near the swamp. You need a Cottage back door key to unlock the back door to enter the villa. The ophthalmoscope can be found in the left hand room on the second floor, inside a potted plant on the table.
